Description: The AWS CloudFormation template for this Serverless application

Properties.Name: api-dev | Validate request body and querystring parameters

Properties.Definition:
schema {
  query: Query
  mutation: Mutation
}

type Query {
  getUpdate(updateID: String!): Update
  getUpdates(nextToken: String): UpdatesPage
  getPlant(plantID: String!): Plant
  getPlants(nextToken: String): PlantsPage
  getPlantsByPost(postID: String!): PlantsPage
  getPost(postID: String!): Post
  getPosts(nextToken: String): PostsPage
  getPostsByPlant(plantID: String!, limit: Int, nextToken: String!): PostsPage
}

type Mutation {
  createUpdate(updateType: UpdateType!, postID: String, plantID: String): Update
  updateUpdate(updateID: String!, updateType: UpdateType!, postID: String, plantID: String): Update
  createPlant(name: String!, description: String, pictures: [String]): Plant
  updatePlant(plantID: String!, name: String, description: String, pictures: [String]): Plant
  deletePlant(plantID: String!): Plant
  createPost(title: String!, content: String, pictures: [String]): Post
  updatePost(postID: String!, title: String, content: String, pictures: [String]): Post
  deletePost(postID: String!): Post
}

type UpdatesPage {
  updates: [Update]
  nextToken: String
  hasMore: Boolean
}

type Update @model @key(fields: ["updateID"]) {
  updateID: ID!
  postID: ID
  plantID: ID
  updateType: UpdateType!
}

enum UpdateType {
  POST_CREATED
  PICTURE_ADDED
  PLANT_ADDED
  PLANT_REMOVED
}

type PlantsPage {
  plants: [Plant]
  nextToken: String
  hasMore: Boolean
}

type Plant @model @key(fields: ["plantID"]) {
  plantID: ID!
  linkedIn: [Post]
  name: String!
  description: String
  pictures: [String]
  createdAt: AWSDateTime!
  updatedAt: AWSDateTime!
}

type PostsPage {
  posts: [Post]
  nextToken: String
  hasMore: Boolean
}

type Post @model @key(fields: ["postID"]) {
  postID: ID!
  linkedPlants: [Plant]
  title: String!
  content: String!
  pictures: [String]
  createdAt: AWSDateTime!
  updatedAt: AWSDateTime!
}
